c.n: Sister Midnight is an upcoming community-owned music venue and radio station based in Catford. We’re on a mission to elevate artists around Lewisham and become a creative hub for all across SE London. Everything we do is driven by our belief in the power of music to uplift, unite and affect positive change. By working at a grassroots level and always democratically, we hope to make this a space for belonging, solidarity and experimentation. Want to help reimagine what a music venue could be? Become a member

c.n: Since 2021, over 1100 members have raised £365,000 to make this happen — and now we need your help to complete the next stage of renovations. We’ve started renovating the Brookdale Club in Catford, and now we need your help to finish! Invest in community shares from £25, every pound is double match funded, and become part of Catford’s first community-owned grassroots music venue.

c.n: Our core values were co-written with our members, and reflect the principles that we believe a community-owned music venue should uphold. These values form the core of our organisational ethics and will inform the choices we make throughout the lifetime of Sister Midnight.
c.txt: Our core values were co-written with our members, and reflect the principles tha

c.n: Champion local music by giving emerging artists from Lewisham and South East London opportunities to perform, grow, and be heard.  Make live music more accessible by creating welcoming, inclusive spaces where more people feel able to take part, on stage and in the audience.  Build a creative hub where musicians, artists, organisers, and audiences can connect, share ideas, and collaborate.
c.txt: Champion local music by giving emerging artists from Lewisham and South East Lon

c.n: Bring people together by creating a space that feels open and welcoming, helping to reduce social isolation and strengthen community connections. Put our community at the centre of what we do, giving members and local people real opportunities to shape our direction and decisions. Support skills and opportunities locally through volunteering, work placements, and training that build confidence, experience, and employability. Strengthen the local economy by working closely with other Lewisham-based businesses, freelancers, and organisations. Build solidarity across South East London by collaborating with like-minded groups to support wellbeing, creativity, and collective resilience.

c.n: Help grow the co-operative cultural sector by sharing knowledge, supporting new initiatives, and working collaboratively within our local area. Stand up for culture by advocating for policies that protect and support grassroots music and community spaces at local, regional, and national levels. Support co-operative and community-owned models by championing fairer, more democratic ways of organising work and resources.
